## Why This Is Asked
Interviews often test real-world integration of native ML with RN, strict latency, and privacy.

## Key Concepts
- On-device ML with platform-specific stacks
- Dedicated native thread for inference
- JS bridge backpressure and event semantics
- Privacy prompts and lifecycle cleanup

## Code Example
```javascript
// Minimal JS bridge sketch
class GestureModule {
  start(config: { gesture: string; fps?: number; sensitivity: number }, cb: (e: any) => void): void;
  stop(): void;
}
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you measure and bound tail latency?
- How to handle model updates and hot-swapping without app restart?
